This project consists of replacing and constructing residential privacy fencing on an existing single-family property in Preston Hollow, Dallas, Texas. The rear yard fence is being replaced from an existing 7-foot fence to a new 8-foot wood privacy fence installed along the rear property line for a total length of 140 linear feet, with height measured from natural grade. Along the side yard facing Royal Lane, an existing 24inch tall City-constructed brick wall located within the build line will remain in place, and a 6-foot wood privacy fence will be installed above the wall, resulting in a combined total height of 8 feet over a span of 70 linear feet. On the interior side yard adjacent to the neighboring property, a privacy fence is proposed to serve a private patio and exterior shower area, consisting of a 16-inch-tall CMU retaining wall with metal posts and an 8-foot wood privacy fence above, resulting in a combined total height of 9 feet 6 inches over 25 linear feet. All 10-foot side yard setbacks are maintained, all recorded survey build lines are respected, no easements are impacted, and no required visibility triangles are obstructed. All work complies with City of Dallas residential fence regulations.
